title: Forge Write Requested
description: Emitted by Forge when a mutating ERP operation is proposed and awaiting approval. v2 adds `reverses` (required, nullable): the write_id of the COMPLETED write this proposal compensates, or null for an ordinary write — making every reversal auditable back to its original. Old producers coerce via Mapper (forge_write_requested_v1_to_v2).

requested_by.description: Actor (agent or user) proposing the write.

diff_preview.description: Rendered before/after diff for reviewer sign-off.

reverses.description: write_id of the completed write this proposal reverses; null for an ordinary write.
